hypothesis: The tied rank-8 D arm's strictly causal next-bit FTRL update lowers exact arithmetic-coded payload relative to P, K, O, R, and S while preserving exact inverse, package, disk, and memory boundaries.
interfaces_exposed: 32-cell terminal bit-head input/candidate preactivations and terminal logit; 512-coded-bit episodic reset; post-truth next-bit update.
kill_condition: Kill on any inverse, repeat, synchronization, identity, finite-arithmetic, disk, RSS, package, cleanup, or D-versus-control failure.
promotion_condition: Promote only if every 250KB arm roundtrips and repeats exactly, C=P, P=K in probability/state/payload, D beats P/K/O/R/S, all controls are live and finite, disk/RSS/package/cleanup gates pass.
title: Decoder-synchronized online FTRL bit-head adapter
